messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

When a claim is received, it is first checked whether the claimant is insured by the organization. If not, the claimant is informed that the claim must be rejected. Otherwise, the severity of the claim is evaluated. Based on the outcome (simple or complex claims), relevant forms are sent to the claimant. Once the forms are returned, they are checked for completeness. If the forms provide all relevant details, the claim is registered in the Claims Management system, which ends the Claims Notification process. Otherwise, the claimant is informed to update the forms. Upon reception of the updated forms, they are checked again.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="ClaimsNotificationProcess" name="Claims Notification Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimReceived" name="Claim Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckInsured</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckInsured" name="Check if Claimant is Insured">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckInsured</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionInsured</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsInsured" name="Is Insured?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionInsured</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInsurance</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesInsurance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RejectClaim" name="Inform Claimant: Claim Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInsurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Claim Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateSeverity" name="Evaluate Severity of Claim">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesInsurance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionSeverity</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Severity" name="Severity Outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionSeverity</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SimpleForms</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ComplexForms</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendSimpleForms" name="Send Simple Forms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SimpleForms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendComplexForms" name="Send Complex Forms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ComplexForms</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FormsReturned" name="Forms Returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForReturn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckCompleteness</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompleteness" name="Check Forms for Completeness">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckCompleteness</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionComplete</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Complete" name="Forms Complete?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionComplete</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompleteNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterClaim" name="Register Claim in Claims Management System">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EndRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Registered" name="Claim Registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EndRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformUpdate" name="Inform Claimant to Update Forms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompleteNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaitForUpdated</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_UpdatedFormsReturned" name="Updated Forms Returned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaitForUpdated</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecheckCompleteness</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckInsured" sourceRef="StartEvent_ClaimReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckInsured" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionInsured" sourceRef="Task_CheckInsured" targetRef="Gateway_IsInsured" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_IsInsured" targetRef="Task_RejectClaim" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesInsurance" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_IsInsured" targetRef="Task_EvaluateSeverity" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndRejected" sourceRef="Task_RejectClaim" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionSeverity" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateSeverity" targetRef="Gateway_Severity" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SimpleForms" name="Simple" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity" targetRef="Task_SendSimpleForms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplexForms" name="Complex" sourceRef="Gateway_Severity" targetRef="Task_SendComplexForms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForReturn" sourceRef="Task_SendSimpleForms" targetRef="Event_FormsReturned" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForReturn_Complex" sourceRef="Task_SendComplexForms" targetRef="Event_FormsReturned" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCompleteness" sourceRef="Event_FormsReturned" targetRef="Task_CheckCompleteness" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionComplete" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompleteness" targetRef="Gateway_Complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Complete" targetRef="Task_RegisterClaim" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompleteNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Complete" targetRef="Task_InformUpdate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EndRegistered" sourceRef="Task_RegisterClaim" targetRef="EndEvent_Registered" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitForUpdated" sourceRef="Task_InformUpdate" targetRef="Event_UpdatedFormsReturned" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecheckCompleteness" sourceRef="Event_UpdatedFormsReturned" targetRef="Task_CheckCompleteness" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
